\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{algorithm}
\usepackage{algorithmic}
\begin{document}
\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Widget count}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\REQUIRE $n \geq 0$
\ENSURE $y = n$
\STATE $y \leftarrow 0$
\FOR{$i = 1$ to $n$}
  \IF{$i$ is odd}
    \STATE $y \leftarrow y + 1$
  \ELSE
    \STATE $y \leftarrow y + 1$ \COMMENT{even}
  \ENDIF
\ENDFOR
\WHILE{$y < 0$} \STATE $y \leftarrow 0$ \ENDWHILE
\RETURN $y$
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
\end{document}
